svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Hardwood 1,400 x 200 x 100 mm, sawn square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the three runner positions on top: 500 mm apart,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the middle one at the centre of the length.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal the ends; chamfer the top edges 10 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It lies flat on firm ground, square to the runners, its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: near edge at least 350 mm back from the rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it lies flat without rocking; the marks are square.
